method: Playwright viewport screenshots at verified CSS viewport dimensions, compared by REA compare_web_screenshots with channel_threshold 0.

provider.name: REA Chrome DevTools Protocol observation provider

limitations: Pixel comparison does not perform OCR, semantic layout analysis, or perceptual color correction.
Only non-interlaced 8-bit RGB and RGBA PNG screenshots are accepted.
PNG tRNS transparency is accepted only as a six-byte RGB color key; tRNS on RGBA or with another length is rejected.
Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
